title: Ex 2.5 #3 · Truth table for ∼(P ⇒ Q)
prompt: Build a truth table for $\sim (P \Rightarrow Q)$ and enter the truth value of the whole statement in each row.
answer_format: Four T/F values, one per row, top to bottom, like T F T T. Rows (P, Q) go TT, TF, FT, FF, as in the book. Helper columns are optional steps, like ~P : F F T T.
hints: First find the column of P ⇒ Q, then negate every value.
P ⇒ Q is false in just one row: P true and Q false.
solution: The column of $P \Rightarrow Q$ is T F T T.
Negating each value gives the column of $\sim (P \Rightarrow Q)$: F T F F.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words. Uses the truth tables for ∧, ∨, ∼, ⇒ and ⇔ (Sections 2.2–2.5).

steps.content: P ⇒ Q : T F T T
